title: CARD9 mediated MAPK/NF-kappaB signal pathway participates in the pathophysiological process of septic hepatitis: The role of tiliroside.
authors: Chen, Runsen; Zhang, Yuxi; Patel, Nishant; Wu, Kede; Li, Manman; Mo, Xuming; Yang, Zhaocong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CARD9介导的MAPK/NF-kB信号通路在脓毒症肝炎中的作用及tiliroside的治疗效果，核心是蛋白信号通路与疾病机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The purpose of the present study was to search for biomarker and effective treatment measures for septic hepatitis. Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) was used to establish septic hepatitis (SH) model in vivo and in vitro. Proteomics, immunoprecipitation, molecular docking techniques, and CARD9 knockout (KO) mice and silence Chang liver Cell(CLC) were used to search for biomarker and possible treatment targets and treatment measures for SH. 46 differentially expressed proteins were found in the liver tissues of sepsis mice, among which CARD9 changed most. CARD9 KO and silence significantly relieved sepsis induced SH in vivo and in vitro. Tiliroside (TIS), an effective component of Buddleja officinalis Maxim, significantly improved SH by regulating CARD9 mediated MAPK/NF-kappaB signal pathway. In conclusion, CARD9 may be the important molecular targets for SH. TIS could protect SH via CARD9 mediated MAPK/NF-kappaB signal pathway. The findings provide a new treatment target for SH and a potential treatment measure.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在寻找脓毒性肝炎的生物标志物及有效治疗措施。采用脂多糖（LPS）在体内和体外建立脓毒性肝炎（SH）模型。利用蛋白质组学、免疫沉淀、分子对接技术以及CARD9基因敲除（KO）小鼠和沉默Chang肝细胞（CLC），以寻找SH的生物标志物、可能的治疗靶点及治疗措施。在脓毒症小鼠肝组织中发现46个差异表达蛋白，其中CARD9变化最为显著。CARD9 KO和沉默在体内和体外均显著缓解了脓毒症诱导的SH。密蒙花（Buddleja officinalis Maxim）的有效成分田蓟苷（TIS）通过调控CARD9介导的MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路，显著改善了SH。总之，CARD9可能是SH的重要分子靶点。TIS可通过CARD9介导的MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路保护SH。这些发现为SH提供了新的治疗靶点和潜在的治疗措施。
